tools.name: get_site_content
tools.title: Get site content
tools.description: Fetch the public portfolio's editable text content (hero, about, contact and other section copy), optionally filtered by section.

section.description: Optional section key to filter by, e.g. about, skills, projects, contact, hero, vision.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.title: List skills
tools.description: List Vamsi's skill categories with their proficiency level and the individual skills in each category.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the category title.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List Vamsi's portfolio projects, including descriptions, tags, challenges, outcomes and demo/GitHub links.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the project title.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default 50).

tools.name: list_experience
tools.title: List experience and credentials
tools.description: List Vamsi's education, internships and certifications — the record of where he studied, worked and what he is certified in.

kind.description: Which record type to return. Defaults to all.

tools.name: list_highlights
tools.title: List ideas, achievements and goals
tools.description: List Vamsi's innovation ideas, achievements and future goals — useful for understanding his interests and direction.

kind.description: Which record type to return. Defaults to all.
